design.source: Public planted feasible repairs; fixed weighted distance to all-zero desired configuration. No optimum filtering.
design.target: V_p=max(0,p-C*), the best objective saving against replacement price p.
design.sampling: All rows of a fixed finite cohort; uniform cohort values and CDF envelopes are deterministic, with no iid generalization claim.

tariff: One unit per named admitted/retained word, logical inspection, arithmetic update, proof node operation or controller operation. Explicit service tariff, not a complete CPU instruction count. Common generation and JSON/hashing harness work have separate timing or are included in arm process/wall time. Objective cost is distinct from proof-service cost.

checks: checked actual objective saturates all looser budgets
frontier queries avoid a new provider call
